messages.subject: Error on logistic regression
parts:
Dear,
I am trying to run a logistic regression. I started by looking at the likelihood models and I got this error with the example code (see below).
The error message was:

Error in have.surv || inla.model.properties(family[i], "likelihood")$survival :
  invalid 'y' type in 'x || y'

I hope you can help to find the origin of the error.

Best,
Inti Pedroso

### START R CODE
rlogistic = function(n, mean = 0, sd = 1){
  p = runif(n)
  A = pi/sqrt(3)
  tauA = A/sd^2
  return ((tauA * mean - log((1-p)/p))/tauA)
}
n=1000
z=rnorm(n,sd=0.1)
eta = 1 + z
y =rlogistic(n,mean=eta,sd=1)

r = inla(y~1+z,data=data.frame(y,z),family="logistic",control.compute=list(cpo=TRUE))

# END R code

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error on logistic regression
parts:
its working fine for me; retry after

inla.upgrade(testing=TRUE)
